# PS-Q3 Feature Dictionary — QML-QCIRCUIT-NOISE (Q3-NOISE-BENCH)

**Source:** Synthetic — generated by simulating random 4-qubit parameterised circuits under two noise regimes.  
**Circuit:** 4 qubits, 3 layers Rx/Ry + ring CNOT entanglement, 1024 shots per instance.  
**Noise threshold:** depolarizing rate p < 0.03 → label 0 (ideal); p ≥ 0.03 → label 1 (noisy).

## Feature columns (24 features)

### Expectation values (10)
| Column | Observable |
|--------|------------|
| exp_z0–exp_z3 | ⟨Zi⟩ single-qubit Pauli Z |
| exp_z0z1, exp_z0z2, exp_z0z3, exp_z1z2, exp_z1z3, exp_z2z3 | ⟨ZiZj⟩ two-qubit ZZ correlators |

### Variance estimates (10)
| Column | Formula |
|--------|---------|
| var_z0–var_z3 | (1 − ⟨Zi⟩²) / 1024 |
| var_z0z1–var_z2z3 | (1 − ⟨ZiZj⟩²) / 1024 |

### Marginal probabilities (4)
| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| marg_q0–marg_q3 | P(qubit i = |0⟩) |

## Label column

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| 0 | Ideal / low-noise (p < 0.03) |
| 1 | Noisy / high-noise (p ≥ 0.03) |

## Files

| File | Samples | Labels |
|------|---------|--------|
| qnoise_train.csv | 2,000 | Yes |
| qnoise_val.csv | 500 | Yes |
| qnoise_test_features.csv | 500 | No — hidden. First column `sample_id` (s0 … s499); it is an identifier, not a feature |

**Class distribution:** ~50/50 (noise rate uniform in [0, 0.06], threshold at 0.03).  
**Official metric:** ROC-AUC, computed from the `score` column of your predictions file (probability that label = 1). F1 is computed from the `label` column, for reference.
